remarks:
Timeless character meets spacious living in this 1840 Federal-style cobblestone with Greek Revival details, set on 50 acres with woods at the rear! Lovingly maintained by its current owner for 32 years, this distinctive home is featured in the Architectural Heritage of Genesee County.

The 1st floor offers an expansive double-size living room and an entertaining-size dining room, both with wide-plank wood flooring. The kitchen features wood cabinetry, an expandable pantry cabinet, granite counters, tile flooring and all appliances. An adjoining hallway provides extensive pantry cabinetry and storage closets, including a concealed laundry area.

A breakfast bar opens to the family room wing, added in the late 1960s–early 1970s, featuring 2 stone walls, a Timberline woodstove and a Rinnai natural gas heater installed in 2016. Exterior doors lead to the rear yard and a covered side patio. A spiral staircase leads to a 2nd floor loft/office with abundant walk-in storage rooms. The 1st floor full bath features a tiled corner shower, tiled walls and flooring, a pedestal sink and a storage cabinet.

Upstairs, the King sized primary bedroom offers wood flooring and a large walk-in closet with built-in drawers. Three additional bedrooms include one with walk-up attic access and a step down to a spacious walk-in closet/dressing room. A 2nd full bath features a solid surfaced walled tub, tile flooring, a pedestal sink and linen storage.

All windows have been replaced and retained the extra deep window sills! Additional features include a Brand new Andersen front Storm door Oct 19th, furnace installed in October 2009, a water heater installed in March 2016. 200-amp electric service and concrete basement floor. A detached 2 car garage built in 2005 and an 1890 barn with 1½ stories complete this Remarkable Property!
